Village in the Shade is a life simulation game created by the team behind the Yomawari series, set in a nostalgic countryside village filled with quiet charm.
Tend your fields and raise livestock,
enjoy fishing and hunting, and build relationships with the people who call the village home, all while soaking in the gentle rhythms of rural life.
Tucked away in the mountains lies small, secluded Karegatsu Village.
Surrounded by scenery that feels straight out of a storybook, this is where your new life begins.
You arrive with nothing more than a weathered little cabin and an overgrown, neglected garden on the edge of town.
Start by clearing the land and planting your first crops, and slowly shape it into a place you can call home.
